text:
Ivy (PM): Thinking out loud 12-week 'fast feedback' DP with rolling intake (2 partners every 2 weeks). Aim: validate onboarding docs, rollout matrix, and our quality/regression monitoring.
Nico (Eng): Rolling intake sounds safer. We'll need clear feature flags per partner and a simple canary controller. Can we commit a one-click rollback?
Harper (ProdOps): Ops can provide a rollback endpoint and sandbox tokens. Need partner signed SLA window + access SOP. Also recommend a 48h pre-onboard smoke test slot.
Jules (Design): We should minimize partner setup friction. Proposal: a one-page Quick Start + an onboarding checklist in Notion. Also capture onboarding time for each step.
Omar (CS): Customer success KPIs: onboarding completion rate, time-to-first-successful-call, and number of escalations. Incentive: $500 credit or extended trial for participating partners.
Ivy (PM): Good. Let's set launch criteria: (A) 6 partners onboarded within 8 weeks, (B) no critical stability regressions for rolling canaries, (C) instrumented feedback loop with weekly synth tests.
Nico (Eng): On the instrumentation: we'll expose per-partner latency, p95/p99, token throughput, and a simple quality probe endpoint for eval harnesses. Suggest adding a health tag so ProdOps can filter partners.
Harper (ProdOps): Agree. Also need a capacity safety net: reserve 10% spare GPU capacity during cohort. If exceeded, automatic throttling to low-cost variant.
Jules (Design): For feedback loop UX: short weekly survey (3 questions), in-app reporter for regressions, and a fortnightly product review call. We'll create templates.
Omar (CS): Escalation path: triage channel -> on-call engineer -> weekly partner sync. SLA: initial response within 2 business hours for P0s during first 2 weeks, then 4 hours afterward.
BetaBot: Note 12 action items created in project board: https://redwood.example.com/projects/fast-feedback-dp
Ivy (PM): Recruitment filter (short): 1) Production or near-prod usage, 2) tokens/day > 10M or strict data-regs, 3) willing to do weekly feedback. Sasha, can you craft sample outreach copy?
Jules (Design): I'll draft outreach + a 1-pager benefits doc (observability screenshots, example ROI) and post in #product by Tue.
Nico (Eng): I'll draft a minimal feature-flag checklist and the rollback playbook (include commands and runbook). Will add simple code snippet: ```curl -X POST /admin/rollback -d '{"partner":"acme"}'```
Harper (ProdOps): I'll prepare access SLA + infra reserve numbers. Also propose a partner onboarding dry-run this Friday.
Omar (CS): I'll prepare the short survey and interview script for product review calls. Also will coordinate credits allocation with finance.
Ivy (PM): Great. Next sync Friday 11am after the dry-run. Please add prospective partner names to the sheet: https://redwood.example.com/sheets/fast-feedback-recruits. Any blockers?
Nico (Eng): None from infra; may need support from eng-sre for canary controller.
Harper (ProdOps): Please remember legal signoff on data processing for private deployments.
Jules (Design): No blockers. Will prioritize one-pager.
Omar (CS): I'll line up 3 customers to pitch.
Ivy (PM): Thanks team 12 let's keep the intake tight and document every ask. If anything big pops up, ping me directly. :rocket:
